topics.title: Essential Auxiliaries: Être & Avoir in Present Tense & Expressions
topics.objective: Conjugate the fundamental irregular verbs *être* (to be) and *avoir* (to have) in the present indicative and apply them in core idiomatic expressions (age, hunger, thirst, feelings).
